data.failurePolicy: Stop on first failed observation; retain all completed and failed evidence
data.mediaCheck: sample per timed observation; separate all-media verification after timing
data.memoryPolicy: Separate instrumented A/B observations after all timing and media verification
data.sourceBoundary: Each revision built independently before timing; no product or harness overlays
data.statistics: Per-host paired median and equal-work ratios; descriptive percentile bootstrap interval of paired median, 10000 complete-pair resamples, seed 897. No pooling hosts or timing from instrumented runs.

data.limits: One host/cohort only; independent opposite-order replication required. Memory observations remain separate.
data.timingInterpretation: Descriptive paired comparison only. A passing correctness/memory status is not a latency or speedup claim.
data.timingScope: File input change through post-UI completion; fresh profile per observation

limitations: Non-atomic sampled observations; short-lived processes and unsampled memory changes can be missed.
Only complete scans wholly inside the marked automation import window contribute to maxima.
Markers bracket dispatch through visible completion and include automation overhead, not readback or restart.
PSS apportions shared mappings; private bytes are reported separately. Neither is an exact peak measurement.
All failed and boundary scans are retained; no missing read is assigned a measured zero.
observations.name: A1
observations.sampling: Linux /proc smaps_rollup; 25 ms wait between scans; non-atomic stable identity/metadata checks
observations.scope: Discovered Chromium process tree from immediately before file-input dispatch through observed UI import completion; startup, media readback and restart excluded from maxima
